title: Merchant Suggest
summary: The "Pay to" box suggests merchants as the customer types. Fix a lookup that misses merchants, build the suggestions, then make them fast enough to answer on every keystroke.
followUps: What does one call to suggest cost now, and what does building your index cost in time and memory?
The three phase 3 tests were slow for different reasons. Name each reason and the change that addressed it.
If you remember answers between calls, when are they thrown away? What would a customer see if you forgot to do that?
The directory changes all day in production, not only at night. Would you still rebuild the whole index on every change? What would you do instead?
What did the assistant get wrong or leave out, and how did you notice?
